fields.caption: Aurora Over Tromsø
fields.alt: A dark silhouette of a mountain peak set against a starry sky with vivid green auroras dancing above Tromsø, Norway.
fields.story: Standing over the fjords of northern Norway, a mountain ridge cuts a clean silhouette against the aurora borealis. The green curtains stretch across the sky above Tromsø, one of the world's prime aurora-watching destinations.
